title: O+/O*+ template-correlation candidate pool is contaminated by suppressed (S-/S--) units
notes: Hamm's suspicion (2026-08-17, in the course of narrowing fig03's O++ population): 'O+ we gotta see why is it 435 since im suspicious many are just S-/S-- appearing as O+'. Checked directly against outputs/classification/grand_oplus_units.csv (435 rows, 359 unique units, pattern_type in {O+, O*+}) joined onto outputs/classification/grand_s_and_o_units.csv's legacy is_Sminus/is_Sminus_double flags on (session_prefix, unit_row_idx): of 359 unique O+/O*+ candidate units, 196 (55%) are ALSO flagged is_Sminus and 154 (43%) are ALSO is_Sminus_double (S--) in the legacy table. Only 4 are also is_Splus. 40 units were never evaluated by the legacy S pipeline (no join match) and can't be checked this way.

Root cause, read directly from scripts/archive_oneoff/find_all_oplus_units.py lines 187-205: the O+/O*+ candidate gate is a Pearson correlation of the unit's 27-element (9 epochs x 3 conditions) rate vector against a one-hot (O+) or two-hot (O*+) template, thresholded at r>0.40 and permutation p<0.05. Pearson correlation is invariant to the vector's absolute scale and to any additive shift consistent across the shuffle test -- it only measures whether the omission-slot epoch(s) sit RELATIVELY higher than the other 8 epochs in that unit's OWN rate vector. A broadly suppressed unit (near-zero or low firing almost everywhere) whose suppression happens to be milder at the omission slot than at the surrounding epochs produces exactly the template's relative shape and clears r>0.4, even though the unit never fires above its own overall/baseline rate at that slot. The only gate in the script that touches absolute firing is line 173 ('cond_rates[...] <= 0.0 -> reject'), which only requires nonzero (not baseline-relative) omission-slot firing -- far too weak to catch this.

Consequence: the 'O+' population feeding fig03 (grand_oplus_units.csv, and everything downstream of it including grand_oplusplus_units.csv / the O++ classifier and panels B/E/F) is not cleanly 'units elevated by the omission', it is a mix of (a) genuinely omission-elevated units and (b) suppressed units whose relative-to-self shape happens to match the template.

QUANTIFIED 2026-08-17 against the CORRECTED (deduplicated) O++ set: a separate row-vs-unique-unit counting bug was found in this same investigation (see bug-oplus-row-vs-unit-count-inflation-20260817) -- the O++ threshold originally reported to and confirmed by Hamm as 'r>=0.67, n=49' was actually 49 ROWS / 42 unique units (7 units qualify under both O+ and O*+ pattern types and were double-counted). Checked the S-/S-- overlap against the corrected 42-unique-unit set directly: 30/42 (71%) are also legacy is_Sminus, 25/42 (60%) are is_Sminus_double (S--) -- a HIGHER contamination rate than the general 435-row candidate pool (55%/43%), not lower. Tightening the correlation threshold clearly does not filter out the contamination; if anything the more stringent cutoff concentrates it. This means whatever population lands near the Hamm-requested ~50 units under any correlation-only threshold should be assumed contaminated at a similar or higher rate until the root-cause fix below is applied upstream of the threshold, not treated as a side benefit of tightening r.
issues: No fix has been implemented yet -- this node records the diagnosis, not a repair. A repair needs an explicit absolute-rate gate (e.g., require the omission-slot rate to exceed the unit's own overall/baseline rate by some margin, not just relatively exceed the OTHER epochs in its own vector) added to the O+/O*+ candidate-generation script, or an explicit exclusion of any candidate independently flagged S-/S-- by whichever S classification is canonical going forward (Hamm decided 2026-08-17 to retire the legacy S+/S++/S-/S-- pipeline entirely for fig03 in favor of the S1 local-baseline table -- see artifacts/.lab/S1-unit-inclusion-rework-in-progress-20260817.json).

plan.falsifier: Closed when the O+/O*+ candidate-generation script gains an absolute-rate (not just relative-shape) gate, is rerun, and the resulting O+ population's overlap with the canonical S-/S-- flag drops to a level Hamm accepts as non-contaminated -- not yet started.

verification.verdict: CONFIRMED as a real contamination finding (55%/43% overlap, root cause identified in code). Repair not yet attempted -- out of this session's scope (fig03 pipeline edits belong to the concurrent Claude Code session per the existing division of labor).
